title: Fix win streak calculation to use consecutive wins from match history

requirements.summary: Fix the current win streak calculation in ProfilePage to count consecutive wins from the most recent match backwards, resetting to 0 on any loss, using match history data only
acceptanceCriteria: Current streak on the Profile tab increments only on consecutive wins from the latest match backwards
Current streak resets to 0 immediately when a loss is encountered in the match history
Current streak does NOT count days with availability or days played

file_operations.description: Fix the `StreakStats` component's current streak calculation logic. Replace the existing logic that incorrectly uses days played or availability data with a loop that iterates through `daysWithLogs` from the most recent day backwards (reverse chronological order), incrementing a counter for each win and immediately stopping (resetting to 0) when a loss is encountered. The current streak value must be derived solely from the wins and losses fields in each `DayWithLog` entry.

requirements.summary: Fix the best (all-time) streak calculation in ProfilePage `computeBestStreak` helper to scan full match history in chronological order, tracking the maximum consecutive win sequence
acceptanceCriteria: Best streak on the Profile tab reflects the longest unbroken sequence of consecutive wins across all match history
Best streak resets its running counter to 0 on any loss and tracks the maximum
Best streak does NOT count days with availability or days played
Example: matches W,W,L,W,W,W,L,W yields best streak of 3

file_operations.description: Fix the `computeBestStreak` helper function to correctly calculate the all-time best win streak. Sort `daysWithLogs` by day in chronological order (oldest first), then iterate through each day's match records. For each day, process wins and losses individually: increment a running counter for each win, reset the counter to 0 for each loss, and track the highest value the counter ever reaches. Return the maximum streak value found. Ensure the logic processes each win and loss separately, not just the net result per day.

requirements.summary: Fix the win streak calculation displayed on the LeaderboardPage to use consecutive wins from match history consistent with the corrected ProfilePage logic
acceptanceCriteria: Win streak values shown on the Leaderboard are consistent with the corrected streak logic used in the Profile tab
Leaderboard streak resets on any loss in match history

file_operations.description: Update the leaderboard display to show win streaks that are calculated from match history data only. If the leaderboard currently displays streak values from the backend stats object (e.g., `stats.streak`), verify that these values align with the corrected streak logic. If the backend `streak` field is being used and is incorrect, add a frontend-side calculation that mirrors the REQ-1 logic: iterate through each user's match history (if available) in reverse chronological order, counting consecutive wins and stopping at the first loss. Display this calculated streak value in the leaderboard table instead of the backend-provided streak.
